---
title: "Descriptive Statistics"
subtitle: "Summarizing Your Data"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
```

## Learning Objectives

1. Calculate measures of central tendency
2. Calculate measures of spread
3. Create summary tables

## Sample Data

```{r}
set.seed(2025)
cell_data <- tibble(
  treatment = rep(c("Control", "Drug_A", "Drug_B"), each = 30),
  viability = c(
    rnorm(30, 95, 5),
    rnorm(30, 75, 10),
    rnorm(30, 85, 8)
  )
)
```

## Measures of Central Tendency

```{r}
# Mean
mean(cell_data$viability)

# Median
median(cell_data$viability)

# Mode (no built-in function)
```

## Measures of Spread

```{r}
# Standard deviation
sd(cell_data$viability)

# Variance
var(cell_data$viability)

# Range
range(cell_data$viability)

# IQR
IQR(cell_data$viability)
```

## Summary by Group

```{r}
cell_data |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(viability),
    sd = sd(viability),
    median = median(viability),
    min = min(viability),
    max = max(viability)
  )
```

## Visualization

```{r}
ggplot(cell_data, aes(x = treatment, y = viability, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "Cell Viability by Treatment", y = "Viability (%)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Exercise

::: {.callout-caution title="Try It"}
Using `iris`, calculate mean and SD of Sepal.Length by Species.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Solution"}
```{r}
iris |>
  group_by(Species) |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Sepal.Length),
    sd = sd(Sepal.Length)
  )
```
:::
